name: Varsity Girls Flag Football
tagline: The Tigers' newest Fall program — girls flag under the lights.

headCoach.name: Daniel Monroe
headCoach.bio: Coach Monroe is in his first season as the head coach of the girls flag football program and his 24th season as a head coach at SLOHS. Monroe will also begin his 17th season as the girls basketball coach, and also teaches Health and AVID at SLOHS.

assistantCoaches.name: Gabe Rodriguez
assistantCoaches.role: Varsity Associate Head Coach / Defensive Coordinator
